title: Revolt of the Altishahr Khojas
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Revolt of the Altishahr Khojas", at revision 1382061284, opens: "The Revolt of the Altishahr Khojas was an uprising against the Qing dynasty of China, which broke out in 1757 during the reign of the Qianlong Emperor. The rebels were led by Khwāja-i Jahān, leader of the White Mountain Sufis. Qing era documents refer to the event as the "Pacification of the Muslim regions". Khwāja Jihān and his brother, Burhān al-Dīn, both held the Muslim title Khoja." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q10935020, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "18th-century uprising in China". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
